title: World of Wordle
tagline: Bringing wordle into web3 using play to earn wow tokens and nfts
description:
Play to earn WOW tokens
🔥 Burn WOW and play
💸 Earn WOW by beating the game
Mint and Stake NFT
🙌 NFT shows your level, higher level higher WOW rewards🏪 Stake your NFT to earn WOW 💪 Flex your NFT .Users can also stake this NFT to earn WOW tokens. As a new wordle is only added once in 24 hours, this incentivises users to play for a long term streak.
how_its_made: ERC20 token WOW is the ignore currency which is given to incentivise users to play more. Users can play game by burning WOW and if they win they will get more WOW tokens. The amount of WOW token user received is a function of the level of the user. The level of the user and the current solution of the wordle is stored in an NFT. Each time a new game is played, the old NFT is burned and a new one is issued with updated level information. Users can also stake this NFT to earn WOW tokens. As a new wordle is only added once in 24 hours, this incentives users to play for a long term streak.
